endpoint.title: Feedback server URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the self-hosted Agentation server, e.g. https://feedback.example.com

brandName.title: Extension name
brandName.description: Name shown in the popup, side panel and toolbar tooltip (default: Agentation)

brandSlogan.title: Slogan
brandSlogan.description: Short line shown under the project name in the popup and side panel (default: Click to add feedbacks), e.g. "Built by Tech Team"
